user.title: Set up HealthLink
user.description: No YAML, webhook URL, token or sensor IDs are required. HealthLink automatically discovers Apple Health sensors from the official Home Assistant iPhone app. Detected iPhones: {device_count}; available for this profile: {available_device_count}.

data_description.companion_device_ids: If one person uses multiple iPhones, you can select them together. Use a separate HealthLink profile for another person's iPhone.

error.device_already_used: One or more selected iPhones already belong to another HealthLink profile.

abort.already_configured: The selected iPhone is already connected to HealthLink.

general.title: General settings
general.description: This is the standard Home Assistant integration settings flow. HealthLink Studio is a separate Home Assistant sidebar panel, not a separate app. Multiple iPhones owned by the same person can be selected together.

data_description.companion_device_ids: Group multiple iPhones for the same person in this profile. Connect another person's phone to a separate HealthLink profile.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: HealthLink stays local. Sensitive health metrics are not exposed as normal Home Assistant entities unless you explicitly allow them.

data.enable_sensitive: Allow sensitive health metrics as HA entities
